text: Lead 2026-10-04: option (A). eyes4s-codec gets a public bound constructor, e.g. ReportSources.tables(queryTables, covariateSource), whose binding is the canonical digest of the tables it reads (streamed via the CanonicalDoc digest when p0-report-digest lands). No lint exception: studio never constructs an unbound report source, and the fake uses the same bound constructor a caching host would.
